title: Timer finished?
prompt: Return true if the timer runs out during this frame, that is, if time_left minus delta is zero or less.
signature: func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> bool:
	return false
solution:
func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> bool:
	return time_left - delta <= 0
